title: Glass Splinter Clap
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A single noise-sculpted clap hit, white noise snapping into pink through a high resonant band-pass with a fast filter-env tick, that broadens from clean clicks into a bit-crushed splintered shatter and back over a 32-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(138/4)
stack(
  s("white*2").struct("x ~ [~ x] x ~ x [x ~ x]")
    .noise(sine.slow(24).range(0, 0.6))
    .bpf(sine.slow(16).range(1800, 7200)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(10, 22)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv("<6 9 4>/4").lpattack(0.001).lpdecay(0.03)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.05).sustain(0).release(0.02)
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 4)).coarse("<1 1 2 4>/8")
    .shape(0.3)
    .hpf(900)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.02, x => x.s("pink").gain(0.35).crush(6).hpf(1400))
    .room(sine.slow(19).range(0.1, 0.4)).delay("0.3:0.1875:0.5")
    .gain(0.9)
)
